scope: Bounded Indian Sign Language camera pilot, initially 30-50 supported lexical signs
operatingRange: Face, torso and required hands visible; hands sufficiently sharp to distinguish the supported signs
notes: These are acceptance goals, not current product accuracy or speed claims.
Video IDs alone do not prove signer separation.
Zero errors in a tiny-set memorization diagnostic are not camera recognition accuracy.
A high precision score obtained by rejecting almost everything does not pass the recall gate.
Fingerspelling and unrestricted continuous language need separate evaluations.
